subject: Zoning Ordinance Overhaul
overview: The Medford Community Development Board held a continued public hearing on proposed revisions to Chapter 94 of the city's zoning ordinance. Consulting attorney Mark Bobrowski presented sections on performance standards, special regulations, housing, planned development districts, and administration, after which the board voted to continue the hearing to January 5, 2022.

items.title: Continued Public Hearing on Chapter 94 Zoning Ordinance Overhaul
items.summary: Attorney Mark Bobrowski presented draft sections covering landscaping, performance standards, special regulations, residential controls, planned development districts, linkage fees, and administrative procedures. The board and public discussed topics including parking minimums, accessory dwelling units, and dwelling definitions, after which the board voted to continue the hearing to January 5, 2022.

items.title: Staff Updates and Upcoming Meetings
items.summary: Planning staff notified the board of a new site plan review application for 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway and reminded members of a December 20 meeting regarding design approval for 23 Sycamore Avenue.
